subject: Velara MAP draft & Mar 28 checkpoint — action items
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Sanders <olivia@velaraanalytics.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv@velaraanalytics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & next steps from discovery call (Velara)

Hi Olivia / Rajiv — great to meet earlier and thanks for sharing your current stack. Per our call, I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan that captures milestones, owners and dependencies so we have a single source of truth while we run the POC. Please find the draft attached and a short summary below. (Attachment: Velara-MAP-v1.0.xlsx)

High level
- Target close: 2026-04-15 (proposed)
- POC timeline: 2 weeks of integration + perf benching

Key milestones (draft)
1) Kickoff & environment access — owner: Velara (Rajiv) — dependency: network allowlist
2) Integration & sample data sync — owner: Redwood (Soojin/Engineering) — dependency: SSO/SAML details from Velara
3) Performance benchmark (P95 latency, cost per 1k tokens) — owner: Redwood Eng / Velara Eng — target week of 4/11
4) Security & procurement review (SOC2 evidence, contract) — owner: both; Legal (Velara) + Security (Redwood) — target 4/8
5) Sign & deploy — owner: Velara procurement + Redwood account team — target close 4/15

Open items for you
- Confirm target close (above) or flag if procurement cadence needs to shift
- Please share SSO/SAML metadata and a point of contact for infrastructure allowlist
- Any constraints on data retention or encryption beyond SOC2?

Next steps
- I will share an updated MAP after we get your SSO metadata and procurement timeline.
- Proposed weekly checkpoint call: Fridays at 10am PT, starting 3/27 — let me know if that works.

Thanks — attaching the MAP v1.0 for your review.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Velara-MAP-v1.0.xlsx)

Thanks, Soojin — helpful framing and appreciate the clear owners. A couple of quick items after internal sync: 

- Procurement at Velara is slower this quarter; can we move target close to 2026-04-22?
- We need a short performance-bench milestone earlier: would you be able to run an initial perf smoke test (small sample) the week of 4/6 and then the more complete bench the week of 4/18?
- I’ll send SSO metadata by EOD Tue (link to our SSO doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2B3cVelara-SSO-specs)

Also cc'ing Rajiv who will manage infra access. Please add a row for "Initial perf smoke test" into the MAP and mark Velara owner for allowlist.

Olivia
Head of Product, Velara Analytics
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & next steps from discovery call (Velara)

Thanks Olivia — great notes. I've made the changes and attached MAP v1.1 with your requested "Initial perf smoke test" on the week of 4/6 and moved the full perf bench to week of 4/18 to give Velara procurement breathing room. (Attachment: Velara-MAP-v1.1.xlsx)

Two important callouts: 
- SOC2 evidence: Redwood can provide our latest SOC2 report and evidence package, but we need 3 business days to provision the secured link to your team once you confirm the people who should receive it.
- SSO metadata: we've added an "SSO config" checklist item and requested the metadata file — thanks for the doc link.

Proposed small change to cadence: weekly checkpoint on Fridays at 10am PT (starting 3/27) — Markus will run the first runbook/technical checklist with your infra lead.

If that sounds good I will circulate the updated MAP and set the recurring invite.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks — 10am PT Fridays works for the recurring checkpoint. Small ask: can we move the full perf benchmark slightly to week of 4/18 instead of 4/11? We need to align with a downstream analytics window. Otherwise ✅ from infra side — I’ll share allowlist details by EOD Thu.

Subject: Velara MAP — week-1 checkpoint nudge & updated MAP v1.2

Hi Olivia / Rajiv — quick checkpoint ahead of our first weekly on Friday. Thanks for the fast turnaround on SSO metadata and allowlist notes (Rajiv). A few updates and outstanding items are flagged below. (Attachment: Velara-MAP-v1.2.xlsx)

Status summary
- SSO metadata: received (Velara) — Redwood Eng has it, configuration in progress.
- Allowlist details: Rajiv to share final IPs by Thu 3/26 — pending (Rajiv)
- SOC2 evidence: pending — Redwood Security to provision link once we confirm recipients (ETA 3 business days after confirmation)
- Initial perf smoke test: scheduled for week of 4/6 (owner: Redwood Eng + Velara Eng)

Overdue / blockers
- SOC2 evidence: ACTION — Velara to confirm recipients for evidence link (status: overdue)
- Procurement PO template: ACTION — Velara procurement to share PO template or process (status: open)

Immediate asks
1) Olivia / Rajiv: Please confirm the two recipients who should receive the SOC2 evidence link by Tue 3/30 so we can provision access.
2) Rajiv: share final allowlist IPs and a contact for the infra test by Thu 3/26 (if you already sent, please re-share — I may have missed it).

I've attached MAP v1.2 (added a Procurement row and a SOC2 evidence checklist). Please update the Status column directly in the sheet and I'll pull in changes before Friday's call.

If we can't confirm SOC2 recipients by Tue 3/30, we should expect a 3–4 business day delay to evidence provisioning and adjust the perf bench date accordingly.

Thanks — see you on the call.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Velara-MAP-v1.2.xlsx)
